question: What did each payer actually pay us for 2028 dates of service, net of reversals?

question: How timely is the claims adjudication feed? By year: records, how many showed up more than 30 days late, and the average lag.
interpretation: Original 1,614-person roster; identity-matched records received on or before the as-of date (2029-08-15) only. No inferred diagnoses, hidden truth or future events. medical_claims rows (all statuses, incl. legacy rows without claim_id) grouped by the year of event_date (adjudication date). Lag = available_date - event_date in days. Columns: year (integer), records, late_over_30d (lag > 30 days), avg_lag_days (mean lag, one decimal).

question: How many encounters are stuck open - started but never closed out?
interpretation: Original 1,614-person roster; identity-matched records received on or before the as-of date (2029-08-15) only. No inferred diagnoses, hidden truth or future events. Encounters de-duplicated by encounter_id. Open = has a row with status 'in_progress' and no row with status 'completed'. Encounters with no status at all (legacy history types) are excluded; 'office'/'pediatric_office' encounters received only as completed are closed. Count of distinct encounter_ids, all types.

question: How many duplicate lab rows do we have - same patient, same test, same draw time, same value?
interpretation: Original 1,614-person roster; identity-matched records received on or before the as-of date (2029-08-15) only. No inferred diagnoses, hidden truth or future events. Labs-stream rows with a non-null event_time, grouped by (patient, test name, event_time, value); duplicates = sum over groups of (rows - 1). Rows differing only by record_id count as duplicates; cancelled rows with null value are grouped on null value. Undated rows excluded.

question: How many patients have no dated blood pressure on file at all?
interpretation: Original 1,614-person roster; identity-matched records received on or before the as-of date (2029-08-15) only. No inferred diagnoses, hidden truth or future events. Dated BP = a vitals row carrying blood_pressure_systolic with an event_date. The undated intake measurement rows (measurement 'bp_systolic'/'bp_diastolic', one per patient) do not count. Count of roster patients with no dated BP.

question: Food insecurity rate among patients who got the needs interview?
interpretation: Original 1,614-person roster; identity-matched records received on or before the as-of date (2029-08-15) only. No inferred diagnoses, hidden truth or future events. Instrument = social_screens with instrument 'brief_clinical_needs_interview' (2028). Latest such interview per patient; positive = food_difficulty_reported true. The 2026 social screens (transport/education/difficulty paying for care) never asked about food and are excluded from the denominator. Percent of interviewed patients, one decimal.

question: How many patients have reported a transportation barrier on any social screen?
interpretation: Original 1,614-person roster; identity-matched records received on or before the as-of date (2029-08-15) only. No inferred diagnoses, hidden truth or future events. Barrier = 2026 social screen with transport 'unreliable' OR 2028 brief_clinical_needs_interview with transport_difficulty_reported true. 'family_ride' and 'reliable' are not barriers. Transport referrals alone do not count. Distinct patients.

question: Of patients who told us they struggle to pay medical bills, how many are on a payment plan?
interpretation: Original 1,614-person roster; identity-matched records received on or before the as-of date (2029-08-15) only. No inferred diagnoses, hidden truth or future events. Financial strain = financial_screens difficulty_paying_medical_bills true (any screen). Payment plan = any medical_payment_plans record for the patient (any date/status). Social screen 'difficulty_paying_for_care_reported' is a different instrument and not used. Distinct patients in both.

question: Break out our diabetic population by race and ethnicity so we can look at disparities.
interpretation: Original 1,614-person roster; identity-matched records received on or before the as-of date (2029-08-15) only. No inferred diagnoses, hidden truth or future events. Requires patient race and ethnicity. The roster carries only display_name, age_reported and sex_reported; no stream records race, ethnicity or Hispanic/Latino origin. Diabetes itself is answerable, the stratifier is not.

expected_behavior.scoring: Scoring: exact unsupported status plus all missing-prerequisite phrase groups; mechanical rubric.
